name: Roster / Content Overview
author: Nullception
description: Every character you play in one window: class, level, combat power, gear score and Odyle energy, with when each one's basic energy is full again; what each has left of Nightmare, Ascension Trial, Daily Dungeon, Shugo Festival, Invasion and the Abyss Corridors, and the Daily Duties completed; and the week's Odyle Energy crafts and shop limits, the Kinah gained today and the week's Abyss Points.
